title: Canonical normalized finite realization tensor transport
statement: For the finite coefficient realization and its derived tensor comparison type of [def-pod-pairing-tensor-normalization], there exists exactly one natural isomorphism satisfying the full K-flat and homogeneous-local-generator normalization specified there. Define the canonical finite realization tensor transport to be this uniquely determined isomorphism. It has direction $R_X(M\otimes_A^L N)\xrightarrow{\sim}R_XM\otimes_{A_X}^LR_XN$, for arbitrary derived fixed-scalar $M,N$, with no boundedness restriction. This definition selects from the uniqueness assertion, never from bare nonemptiness.
